items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 May 2026 4:09am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 13 May 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, and low pressure in the North Sea as various troughs affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or northwest, quickly veering northwest, 5 to 7, veering north or northwest 4 to 6 overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate and occasionally rough in the east to start.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, heavy in places, becoming isolated in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 4 to 6, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or showers soon becoming isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
